# =====================================================================
# STEP 7: TRPO-ED3QN HYBRID POLICY OPTIMIZATION
# Complete corrected implementation for Keras 3 and SciPy SLSQP
# =====================================================================

import os
import re
import json
import zipfile
import tempfile
import warnings
import h5py

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from scipy.optimize import minimize
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# =====================================================================
# 1. REPRODUCIBILITY
# =====================================================================

SEED = 42

np.random.seed(SEED)
tf.random.set_seed(SEED)

# =====================================================================
# 2. PATH CONFIGURATION
# =====================================================================

BASE_DIR = r"/content/drive/MyDrive/Datas/4905"

STEP5_DIR = os.path.join(
    BASE_DIR,
    "Step5_MDP_Environment"
)

STEP6_DIR = os.path.join(
    BASE_DIR,
    "Step6_ED3QN_Agent"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = os.path.join(
    BASE_DIR,
    "Step7_TRPO_ED3QN_Hybrid"
)

os.makedirs(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    exist_ok=True
)

MODEL_PATH = os.path.join(
    STEP6_DIR,
    "ED3QN_Best_Model.keras"
)

TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(
    STEP5_DIR,
    "MDP_Transitions_Train.csv"
)

VAL_PATH = os.path.join(
    STEP5_DIR,
    "MDP_Transitions_Validation.csv"
)

TEST_PATH = os.path.join(
    STEP5_DIR,
    "MDP_Transitions_Test.csv"
)

# =====================================================================
# 3. CONFIGURATION
# =====================================================================

STATE_DIM = 22
ACTION_DIM = 4

KL_LIMIT = 0.01
TRPO_ITERATIONS = 10

OPTIMIZATION_SIZE = 4096
OPTIMIZER_MAX_ITERATIONS = 30

BATCH_SIZE = 512

ACTION_NAMES = {
    0: "Local",
    1: "Edge Server 1",
    2: "Edge Server 2",
    3: "Cloud"
}

print("=" * 75)
print("STEP 7: TRPO-ED3QN HYBRID POLICY OPTIMIZATION")
print("=" * 75)

# =====================================================================
# 4. CHECK INPUT FILES
# =====================================================================

required_files = [
    MODEL_PATH,
    TRAIN_PATH,
    VAL_PATH,
    TEST_PATH
]

for path in required_files:

    if not os.path.exists(path):

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Required file not found:\n{path}"
        )

# =====================================================================
# 5. LOAD MDP TRANSITION DATA
# =====================================================================

train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
val_df = pd.read_csv(VAL_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

print("\nDataset Shapes:")
print("Training  :", train_df.shape)
print("Validation:", val_df.shape)
print("Testing   :", test_df.shape)

# =====================================================================
# 6. EXTRACT STATE FEATURES
# =====================================================================

def get_state_columns(df):

    columns = [
        col for col in df.columns
        if re.fullmatch(
            r"state_\d+",
            str(col)
        )
    ]

    columns = sorted(
        columns,
        key=lambda x: int(x.split("_")[1])
    )

    if len(columns) != STATE_DIM:

        raise ValueError(
            f"Expected {STATE_DIM} state columns, "
            f"found {len(columns)}."
        )

    return columns


state_columns = get_state_columns(train_df)

if get_state_columns(val_df) != state_columns:
    raise ValueError(
        "Validation state columns do not match training."
    )

if get_state_columns(test_df) != state_columns:
    raise ValueError(
        "Test state columns do not match training."
    )


X_train = train_df[
    state_columns
].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)

X_val = val_df[
    state_columns
].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)

X_test = test_df[
    state_columns
].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)


if not (
    np.isfinite(X_train).all()
    and np.isfinite(X_val).all()
    and np.isfinite(X_test).all()
):

    raise ValueError(
        "State data contains NaN or infinite values."
    )


print("\nState Dimension:", X_train.shape[1])
print("Action Dimension:", ACTION_DIM)

# =====================================================================
# 7. RECONSTRUCT EXACT ED3QN ARCHITECTURE
# =====================================================================

class DuelingAggregation(layers.Layer):

    def call(self, inputs):

        value, advantage = inputs

        return value + (
            advantage -
            tf.reduce_mean(
                advantage,
                axis=1,
                keepdims=True
            )
        )


def build_ed3qn_model():

    inputs = layers.Input(
        shape=(STATE_DIM,),
        name="state_input"
    )

    # Shared feature extraction
    x = layers.Dense(
        256,
        activation="relu",
        name="dense"
    )(inputs)

    x = layers.Dense(
        128,
        activation="relu",
        name="dense_1"
    )(x)

    x = layers.Dense(
        64,
        activation="relu",
        name="dense_2"
    )(x)

    # Advantage branch
    advantage_hidden = layers.Dense(
        32,
        activation="relu",
        name="dense_3"
    )(x)

    advantage_output = layers.Dense(
        ACTION_DIM,
        activation=None,
        name="dense_4"
    )(advantage_hidden)

    # State-value branch
    value_hidden = layers.Dense(
        32,
        activation="relu",
        name="dense_5"
    )(x)

    value_output = layers.Dense(
        1,
        activation=None,
        name="dense_6"
    )(value_hidden)

    # Dueling aggregation
    q_values = DuelingAggregation(
        name="dueling_aggregation"
    )([
        value_output,
        advantage_output
    ])

    model = Model(
        inputs=inputs,
        outputs=q_values,
        name="ED3QN"
    )

    return model


# =====================================================================
# 8. EXTRACT ED3QN WEIGHTS FROM KERAS ARCHIVE
# =====================================================================

print("\nExtracting ED3QN model weights...")

temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(
    prefix="ed3qn_weights_"
)

with zipfile.ZipFile(
    MODEL_PATH,
    "r"
) as archive:

    weight_files = [
        name for name in archive.namelist()
        if name.endswith("model.weights.h5")
    ]

    if not weight_files:

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            "model.weights.h5 not found inside ED3QN .keras archive."
        )

    archive.extract(
        weight_files[0],
        temp_dir
    )


weights_path = os.path.join(
    temp_dir,
    weight_files[0]
)

# =====================================================================
# 9. READ SAVED HDF5 WEIGHT GROUPS
# =====================================================================

print("Reading saved HDF5 weight groups...")

saved_weights = {}


def collect_weight_groups(group):

    for key in group.keys():

        item = group[key]

        if isinstance(item, h5py.Group):

            if key == "vars":

                parent_name = group.name.split("/")[-1]

                arrays = []

                dataset_keys = sorted(
                    item.keys(),
                    key=lambda x: int(x)
                    if str(x).isdigit()
                    else str(x)
                )

                for dataset_key in dataset_keys:

                    dataset = item[dataset_key]

                    if isinstance(
                        dataset,
                        h5py.Dataset
                    ):

                        arrays.append(
                            dataset[()]
                        )

                if arrays:

                    saved_weights[parent_name] = arrays

            else:

                collect_weight_groups(item)


with h5py.File(
    weights_path,
    "r"
) as h5_file:

    collect_weight_groups(h5_file)


print("\nSaved Weight Groups:")

for name, arrays in saved_weights.items():

    print(
        name,
        [
            array.shape
            for array in arrays
        ]
    )


# =====================================================================
# 10. BUILD AND TRANSFER ED3QN WEIGHTS
# =====================================================================

print("\nReconstructing ED3QN architecture...")

ed3qn_model = build_ed3qn_model()

model_layers = {
    layer.name: layer
    for layer in ed3qn_model.layers
}

expected_layer_names = [
    "dense",
    "dense_1",
    "dense_2",
    "dense_3",
    "dense_4",
    "dense_5",
    "dense_6"
]

print("\nTransferring ED3QN weights...")

for layer_name in expected_layer_names:

    if layer_name not in saved_weights:

        raise ValueError(
            f"Saved weight group missing: {layer_name}"
        )

    if layer_name not in model_layers:

        raise ValueError(
            f"Reconstructed layer missing: {layer_name}"
        )

    source_arrays = saved_weights[
        layer_name
    ]

    target_layer = model_layers[
        layer_name
    ]

    target_weights = target_layer.get_weights()

    if len(source_arrays) != len(target_weights):

        raise ValueError(
            f"Weight count mismatch in {layer_name}."
        )

    for index, (
        source,
        target
    ) in enumerate(
        zip(source_arrays, target_weights)
    ):

        if source.shape != target.shape:

            raise ValueError(
                f"Shape mismatch in {layer_name}, "
                f"weight {index}: "
                f"saved={source.shape}, "
                f"target={target.shape}"
            )

    target_layer.set_weights(
        source_arrays
    )

    print(
        "Transferred:",
        layer_name,
        [
            array.shape
            for array in source_arrays
        ]
    )


# =====================================================================
# 11. VERIFY RECONSTRUCTED ED3QN MODEL
# =====================================================================

print("\nVerifying reconstructed ED3QN model...")

sample_output = ed3qn_model(
    X_train[:10],
    training=False
).numpy()

print(
    "ED3QN output shape:",
    sample_output.shape
)

if sample_output.shape != (
    10,
    ACTION_DIM
):

    raise ValueError(
        "Incorrect ED3QN output shape."
    )

if not np.isfinite(sample_output).all():

    raise ValueError(
        "ED3QN produced invalid Q-values."
    )

print(
    "ED3QN weight reconstruction successful."
)


# =====================================================================
# 12. GENERATE ED3QN Q-VALUES
# =====================================================================

print("\nGenerating ED3QN Q-values...")

Q_train = ed3qn_model.predict(
    X_train,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    verbose=1
)

Q_val = ed3qn_model.predict(
    X_val,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    verbose=1
)

Q_test = ed3qn_model.predict(
    X_test,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    verbose=1
)

print("\nQ-value Shapes:")
print("Training  :", Q_train.shape)
print("Validation:", Q_val.shape)
print("Testing   :", Q_test.shape)


# =====================================================================
# 13. BUILD TRPO POLICY NETWORK
# =====================================================================

def build_policy_model():

    inputs = layers.Input(
        shape=(STATE_DIM,),
        name="policy_state"
    )

    x = layers.Dense(
        128,
        activation="tanh",
        name="policy_dense_1"
    )(inputs)

    x = layers.Dense(
        64,
        activation="tanh",
        name="policy_dense_2"
    )(x)

    outputs = layers.Dense(
        ACTION_DIM,
        activation="softmax",
        name="policy_output"
    )(x)

    return Model(
        inputs=inputs,
        outputs=outputs,
        name="TRPO_Policy"
    )


policy = build_policy_model()

print("\nTRPO Policy Summary:")
policy.summary()


# =====================================================================
# 14. FLATTEN AND RESTORE POLICY PARAMETERS
# IMPORTANT: SCIPY REQUIRES FLOAT64 ARRAYS
# =====================================================================

def get_flat_parameters(model):

    return np.ascontiguousarray(
        np.concatenate([
            weight.numpy().ravel()
            for weight in model.trainable_variables
        ]).astype(np.float64)
    )


def set_flat_parameters(
    model,
    flat_parameters
):

    flat_parameters = np.asarray(
        flat_parameters,
        dtype=np.float64
    )

    position = 0

    for variable in model.trainable_variables:

        size = int(
            np.prod(variable.shape)
        )

        values = flat_parameters[
            position:position + size
        ]

        variable_dtype = tf.as_dtype(
            variable.dtype
        ).as_numpy_dtype

        variable.assign(
            values.reshape(
                variable.shape
            ).astype(variable_dtype)
        )

        position += size

    if position != len(flat_parameters):

        raise ValueError(
            "Parameter vector length does not match policy weights."
        )


# =====================================================================
# 15. PREPARE POLICY OPTIMIZATION DATA
# =====================================================================

print("\nPreparing policy optimization data...")

rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)

optimization_size = min(
    OPTIMIZATION_SIZE,
    len(X_train)
)

optimization_indices = rng.choice(
    len(X_train),
    size=optimization_size,
    replace=False
)

X_opt = X_train[
    optimization_indices
]

Q_opt = Q_train[
    optimization_indices
]

# ED3QN greedy actions
target_actions = np.argmax(
    Q_opt,
    axis=1
).astype(np.int32)

# Surrogate Q-value advantages
selected_q = Q_opt[
    np.arange(len(Q_opt)),
    target_actions
]

advantages = (
    selected_q -
    np.mean(Q_opt, axis=1)
)

advantages = (
    advantages - np.mean(advantages)
) / (
    np.std(advantages) + 1e-8
)

advantages = np.clip(
    advantages,
    -5.0,
    5.0
).astype(np.float32)

# TensorFlow tensors
X_opt_tf = tf.convert_to_tensor(
    X_opt,
    dtype=tf.float32
)

actions_tf = tf.convert_to_tensor(
    target_actions,
    dtype=tf.int32
)

advantages_tf = tf.convert_to_tensor(
    advantages,
    dtype=tf.float32
)

print(
    "Optimization Samples:",
    len(X_opt)
)

print(
    "Optimization State Shape:",
    X_opt.shape
)


# =====================================================================
# 16. POLICY OBJECTIVE AND GRADIENT
# =====================================================================

def calculate_objective_and_gradient(
    flat_parameters,
    old_probabilities
):

    set_flat_parameters(
        policy,
        flat_parameters
    )

    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:

        probabilities = policy(
            X_opt_tf,
            training=False
        )

        selected_probabilities = tf.gather(
            probabilities,
            actions_tf,
            axis=1,
            batch_dims=1
        )

        selected_probabilities = tf.clip_by_value(
            selected_probabilities,
            1e-8,
            1.0
        )

        objective = -tf.reduce_mean(
            advantages_tf *
            tf.math.log(selected_probabilities)
        )

    gradients = tape.gradient(
        objective,
        policy.trainable_variables
    )

    if any(
        gradient is None
        for gradient in gradients
    ):

        raise ValueError(
            "A policy objective gradient is None."
        )

    flat_gradient = np.concatenate([
        gradient.numpy().ravel()
        for gradient in gradients
    ])

    return (
        float(objective.numpy()),
        np.ascontiguousarray(
            flat_gradient.astype(np.float64)
        )
    )


# =====================================================================
# 17. KL DIVERGENCE AND GRADIENT
# =====================================================================

def calculate_kl_and_gradient(
    flat_parameters,
    old_probabilities
):

    set_flat_parameters(
        policy,
        flat_parameters
    )

    old_prob_tf = tf.convert_to_tensor(
        old_probabilities,
        dtype=tf.float32
    )

    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:

        new_probabilities = policy(
            X_opt_tf,
            training=False
        )

        old_prob_safe = tf.clip_by_value(
            old_prob_tf,
            1e-8,
            1.0
        )

        new_prob_safe = tf.clip_by_value(
            new_probabilities,
            1e-8,
            1.0
        )

        kl = tf.reduce_mean(
            tf.reduce_sum(
                old_prob_safe * (
                    tf.math.log(old_prob_safe) -
                    tf.math.log(new_prob_safe)
                ),
                axis=1
            )
        )

    gradients = tape.gradient(
        kl,
        policy.trainable_variables
    )

    if any(
        gradient is None
        for gradient in gradients
    ):

        raise ValueError(
            "A KL divergence gradient is None."
        )

    flat_gradient = np.concatenate([
        gradient.numpy().ravel()
        for gradient in gradients
    ])

    return (
        float(kl.numpy()),
        np.ascontiguousarray(
            flat_gradient.astype(np.float64)
        )
    )


# =====================================================================
# 18. TRPO-STYLE KL-CONSTRAINED OPTIMIZATION
# =====================================================================

print(
    "\nStarting KL-constrained policy optimization..."
)

training_history = []

for iteration in range(
    TRPO_ITERATIONS
):

    print(
        f"\nTRPO Optimization Iteration "
        f"{iteration + 1}/{TRPO_ITERATIONS}"
    )

    # Store old policy
    old_parameters = get_flat_parameters(
        policy
    )

    old_probabilities = policy.predict(
        X_opt,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        verbose=0
    ).astype(np.float64)

    old_probabilities = np.ascontiguousarray(
        old_probabilities
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # Objective function
    # -------------------------------------------------------------

    def objective_function(parameters):

        parameters = np.ascontiguousarray(
            np.asarray(
                parameters,
                dtype=np.float64
            )
        )

        value, gradient = (
            calculate_objective_and_gradient(
                parameters,
                old_probabilities
            )
        )

        return (
            np.float64(value),
            np.ascontiguousarray(
                gradient,
                dtype=np.float64
            )
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # KL constraint
    # -------------------------------------------------------------

    def kl_constraint(parameters):

        parameters = np.ascontiguousarray(
            np.asarray(
                parameters,
                dtype=np.float64
            )
        )

        kl_value, _ = (
            calculate_kl_and_gradient(
                parameters,
                old_probabilities
            )
        )

        return np.float64(
            KL_LIMIT - kl_value
        )

    def kl_constraint_jacobian(parameters):

        parameters = np.ascontiguousarray(
            np.asarray(
                parameters,
                dtype=np.float64
            )
        )

        _, kl_gradient = (
            calculate_kl_and_gradient(
                parameters,
                old_probabilities
            )
        )

        return np.ascontiguousarray(
            -kl_gradient,
            dtype=np.float64
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # SLSQP optimization
    # -------------------------------------------------------------

    result = minimize(
        fun=lambda p: objective_function(p)[0],
        x0=np.asarray(
            old_parameters,
            dtype=np.float64
        ),
        jac=lambda p: objective_function(p)[1],
        method="SLSQP",
        constraints=[
            {
                "type": "ineq",
                "fun": kl_constraint,
                "jac": kl_constraint_jacobian
            }
        ],
        options={
            "maxiter": OPTIMIZER_MAX_ITERATIONS,
            "ftol": 1e-7,
            "disp": False
        }
    )

    candidate_parameters = np.asarray(
        result.x,
        dtype=np.float64
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # Evaluate proposed candidate
    # -------------------------------------------------------------

    candidate_objective, _ = (
        calculate_objective_and_gradient(
            candidate_parameters,
            old_probabilities
        )
    )

    candidate_kl, _ = (
        calculate_kl_and_gradient(
            candidate_parameters,
            old_probabilities
        )
    )

    # Restore old policy
    set_flat_parameters(
        policy,
        old_parameters
    )

    old_objective, _ = (
        calculate_objective_and_gradient(
            old_parameters,
            old_probabilities
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # Accept or reject candidate
    # -------------------------------------------------------------

    accepted = (
        np.isfinite(candidate_objective)
        and np.isfinite(candidate_kl)
        and candidate_objective < old_objective
        and candidate_kl <= KL_LIMIT + 1e-6
    )

    if accepted:

        set_flat_parameters(
            policy,
            candidate_parameters
        )

        print(
            "Candidate accepted."
        )

    else:

        set_flat_parameters(
            policy,
            old_parameters
        )

        print(
            "Candidate rejected; "
            "previous policy retained."
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validation expected Q-value
    # -------------------------------------------------------------

    validation_probabilities = policy.predict(
        X_val,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        verbose=0
    )

    validation_expected_q = np.mean(
        np.sum(
            validation_probabilities * Q_val,
            axis=1
        )
    )

    # Current policy objective and KL
    current_parameters = get_flat_parameters(
        policy
    )

    current_objective, _ = (
        calculate_objective_and_gradient(
            current_parameters,
            old_probabilities
        )
    )

    current_kl, _ = (
        calculate_kl_and_gradient(
            current_parameters,
            old_probabilities
        )
    )

    training_history.append({

        "Iteration": iteration + 1,

        "Objective": float(
            current_objective
        ),

        "Validation_Expected_Q": float(
            validation_expected_q
        ),

        "KL_Divergence": float(
            current_kl
        ),

        "Candidate_Accepted": int(
            accepted
        ),

        "Optimizer_Success": int(
            result.success
        ),

        "Optimizer_Message": str(
            result.message
        )
    })

    print(
        f"Objective: {current_objective:.6f} | "
        f"Validation Expected Q: "
        f"{validation_expected_q:.6f} | "
        f"KL: {current_kl:.8f} | "
        f"Accepted: {accepted}"
    )


# =====================================================================
# 19. SAVE TRAINING HISTORY
# =====================================================================

history_df = pd.DataFrame(
    training_history
)

history_df.to_csv(

)

print("\nOptimization history saved.")


# =====================================================================
# 20. VALIDATION EVALUATION
# =====================================================================

print("\nPerforming validation evaluation...")

validation_probabilities = policy.predict(
    X_val,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    verbose=0
)

validation_expected_q_values = np.sum(
    validation_probabilities * Q_val,
    axis=1
)

validation_expected_q = float(
    np.mean(validation_expected_q_values)
)

validation_actions = np.argmax(
    validation_probabilities,
    axis=1
)

validation_summary = pd.DataFrame([{

    "Validation_Samples": len(X_val),

    "Validation_Expected_Q": validation_expected_q,

    "Mean_Policy_Confidence": float(
        np.mean(
            np.max(
                validation_probabilities,
                axis=1
            )
        )
    ),

    "KL_Limit": KL_LIMIT

}])

validation_summary.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "TRPO_Validation_Metrics.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

print(
    "Validation Expected Q:",
    validation_expected_q
)


# =====================================================================
# 21. FINAL TEST EVALUATION
# =====================================================================

print("\nEvaluating final TRPO-ED3QN policy...")

test_probabilities = policy.predict(
    X_test,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    verbose=1
)

test_actions = np.argmax(
    test_probabilities,
    axis=1
)

# Expected Q under the policy distribution
test_expected_q = np.sum(
    test_probabilities * Q_test,
    axis=1
)

# Q-value for selected greedy action
test_selected_q = Q_test[
    np.arange(len(Q_test)),
    test_actions
]

# ED3QN maximum Q-value
test_max_q = np.max(
    Q_test,
    axis=1
)

test_metrics = {

    "Test_Samples": len(X_test),

    "State_Dimension": STATE_DIM,

    "Action_Dimension": ACTION_DIM,

    "Mean_Policy_Expected_Q": float(
        np.mean(test_expected_q)
    ),

    "Mean_Selected_Action_Q": float(
        np.mean(test_selected_q)
    ),

    "Mean_ED3QN_Max_Q": float(
        np.mean(test_max_q)
    ),

    "Mean_Policy_Confidence": float(
        np.mean(
            np.max(
                test_probabilities,
                axis=1
            )
        )
    ),

    "Validation_Expected_Q": validation_expected_q

}

metrics_df = pd.DataFrame(
    [test_metrics]
)

metrics_df.to_csv(
    os.path.join(

)

for key, value in test_metrics.items():

    print(
        f"{key}: {value}"
    )

# =====================================================================
# STEP 8: COMPREHENSIVE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
# TRPO-ED3QN HYBRID EDGE OFFLOADING FRAMEWORK
# =====================================================================

import os
import re
import json
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    precision_score,
    recall_score,
    f1_score,
    balanced_accuracy_score,
    confusion_matrix,
    classification_report
)

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# =====================================================================
# 1. REPRODUCIBILITY
# =====================================================================

SEED = 42

np.random.seed(SEED)
tf.random.set_seed(SEED)

# =====================================================================
# 2. PATH CONFIGURATION
# =====================================================================

BASE_DIR = "/content/drive/MyDrive/Datas/4905"

STEP5_DIR = os.path.join(
    BASE_DIR,
    "Step5_MDP_Environment"
)

STEP6_DIR = os.path.join(
    BASE_DIR,
    "Step6_ED3QN_Agent"
)

STEP7_DIR = os.path.join(
    BASE_DIR,
    "Step7_TRPO_ED3QN_Hybrid"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = os.path.join(
    BASE_DIR,
    "Step8_Performance_Evaluation"
)

os.makedirs(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    exist_ok=True
)

TEST_PATH = os.path.join(
    STEP5_DIR,
    "MDP_Transitions_Test.csv"
)

PREDICTION_PATH = os.path.join(
    STEP7_DIR,
    "TRPO_ED3QN_Test_Predictions.csv"
)

POLICY_PATH = os.path.join(
    STEP7_DIR,
    "TRPO_Policy.keras"
)

ED3QN_PATH = os.path.join(
    STEP7_DIR,
    "ED3QN_Reconstructed.keras"
)

HISTORY_PATH = os.path.join(
    STEP7_DIR,
    "TRPO_Training_History.csv"
)

# =====================================================================
# 3. ACTION CONFIGURATION
# =====================================================================

ACTION_IDS = [0, 1, 2, 3]

ACTION_NAMES = {
    0: "Local",
    1: "Edge Server 1",
    2: "Edge Server 2",
    3: "Cloud"
}

print("=" * 75)
print("STEP 8: TRPO-ED3QN PERFORMANCE EVALUATION")
print("=" * 75)

# =====================================================================
# 4. VERIFY INPUT FILES
# =====================================================================

required_files = [
    TEST_PATH,
    PREDICTION_PATH,
    POLICY_PATH,
    ED3QN_PATH
]

for path in required_files:

    if not os.path.exists(path):

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Required file not found: {path}"
        )

# =====================================================================
# 5. LOAD DATA
# =====================================================================

test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

prediction_df = pd.read_csv(
    PREDICTION_PATH
)

print("\nDataset Shapes:")
print("Test Dataset:", test_df.shape)
print("Predictions :", prediction_df.shape)

if len(test_df) != len(prediction_df):

    raise ValueError(
        "Test dataset and prediction row counts do not match."
    )

# =====================================================================
# 6. LOAD TRAINED MODELS
# =====================================================================

print("\nLoading trained models...")

policy = tf.keras.models.load_model(
    POLICY_PATH,
    compile=False
)


class DuelingAggregation(tf.keras.layers.Layer):

    def call(self, inputs):

        value, advantage = inputs

        return value + (
            advantage -
            tf.reduce_mean(
                advantage,
                axis=1,
                keepdims=True
            )
        )


ed3qn_model = tf.keras.models.load_model(
    ED3QN_PATH,
    custom_objects={
        "DuelingAggregation": DuelingAggregation
    },
    compile=False
)

print("TRPO policy loaded successfully.")
print("ED3QN model loaded successfully.")

# =====================================================================
# 7. IDENTIFY STATE FEATURES
# =====================================================================

state_columns = [
    col for col in test_df.columns
    if re.fullmatch(
        r"state_\d+",
        str(col)
    )
]

state_columns = sorted(
    state_columns,
    key=lambda x: int(x.split("_")[1])
)

if len(state_columns) != 22:

    raise ValueError(
        f"Expected 22 state columns, found {len(state_columns)}."
    )

X_test = test_df[
    state_columns
].to_numpy(
    dtype=np.float32
)

print("\nState Matrix:", X_test.shape)

if not np.isfinite(X_test).all():

    raise ValueError(
        "State matrix contains NaN or infinite values."
    )

# =====================================================================
# 8. IDENTIFY RECORDED ACTIONS
# =====================================================================

def find_column(dataframe, candidates):

    lower_map = {
        str(col).lower(): col
        for col in dataframe.columns
    }

    for candidate in candidates:

        if candidate.lower() in lower_map:

            return lower_map[candidate.lower()]

    return None


action_column = find_column(
    test_df,
    [
        "action",
        "action_id",
        "recorded_action",
        "offloading_action",
        "offloading_decision",
        "selected_action"
    ]
)

if action_column is None:

    raise ValueError(
        "Recorded action column not found. "
        "Available columns:\n"
        + str(test_df.columns.tolist())
    )

recorded_actions = pd.to_numeric(
    test_df[action_column],
    errors="coerce"
).to_numpy()

if not np.isfinite(recorded_actions).all():

    raise ValueError(
        "Recorded action contains invalid values."
    )

recorded_actions = recorded_actions.astype(int)

if not np.isin(
    recorded_actions,
    ACTION_IDS
).all():

    raise ValueError(
        "Unexpected recorded action values."
    )

print("\nRecorded Action Column:", action_column)

# =====================================================================
# 9. GENERATE ED3QN AND TRPO PREDICTIONS
# =====================================================================

print("\nGenerating ED3QN Q-values...")

Q_test = ed3qn_model.predict(
    X_test,
    batch_size=512,
    verbose=1
)

print("\nGenerating TRPO Policy Probabilities...")

policy_probabilities = policy.predict(
    X_test,
    batch_size=512,
    verbose=1
)

if Q_test.shape != (
    len(X_test),
    4
):

    raise ValueError(
        "Unexpected ED3QN Q-value shape."
    )

if policy_probabilities.shape != (
    len(X_test),
    4
):

    raise ValueError(
        "Unexpected policy probability shape."
    )

ed3qn_actions = np.argmax(
    Q_test,
    axis=1
)

trpo_actions = np.argmax(
    policy_probabilities,
    axis=1
)

print("\nPrediction Shapes:")
print("ED3QN:", Q_test.shape)
print("TRPO :", policy_probabilities.shape)

# =====================================================================
# 10. Q-VALUE AND POLICY METRICS
# =====================================================================

ed3qn_max_q = np.max(
    Q_test,
    axis=1
)

ed3qn_selected_q = Q_test[
    np.arange(len(X_test)),
    ed3qn_actions
]

trpo_selected_q = Q_test[
    np.arange(len(X_test)),
    trpo_actions
]

trpo_expected_q = np.sum(
    policy_probabilities * Q_test,
    axis=1
)

policy_confidence = np.max(
    policy_probabilities,
    axis=1
)

epsilon = 1e-10

policy_entropy = -np.sum(
    policy_probabilities *
    np.log(
        np.clip(
            policy_probabilities,
            epsilon,
            1.0
        )
    ),
    axis=1
)

normalized_entropy = (
    policy_entropy /
    np.log(4)
)

# =====================================================================
# 11. ACTION AGREEMENT METRICS
# =====================================================================

def calculate_metrics(
    actual,
    predicted,
    method
):

    return {

        "Model": method,

        "Action_Agreement_Percentage": (
            accuracy_score(
                actual,
                predicted
            ) * 100
        ),

        "Balanced_Action_Agreement": (
            balanced_accuracy_score(
                actual,
                predicted
            )
        ),

        "Macro_Precision": precision_score(
            actual,
            predicted,
            average="macro",
            zero_division=0
        ),

        "Macro_Recall": recall_score(
            actual,
            predicted,
            average="macro",
            zero_division=0
        ),

        "Macro_F1": f1_score(
            actual,
            predicted,
            average="macro",
            zero_division=0
        ),

        "Weighted_F1": f1_score(
            actual,
            predicted,
            average="weighted",
            zero_division=0
        )

    }


decision_metrics = pd.DataFrame([

    calculate_metrics(
        recorded_actions,
        ed3qn_actions,
        "ED3QN"
    ),

    calculate_metrics(
        recorded_actions,
        trpo_actions,
        "TRPO-ED3QN"
    )

])

decision_metrics.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "Step8_Decision_Agreement_Metrics.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

print("\nDecision Agreement Metrics:")
print(decision_metrics)

print(
    "\nThese metrics measure agreement with recorded decisions, "
    "not verified optimal-action accuracy."
)

# =====================================================================
# 12. ACTION DISTRIBUTION COMPARISON
# =====================================================================

def get_action_distribution(
    actions,
    method
):

    counts = pd.Series(
        actions
    ).value_counts().reindex(
        ACTION_IDS,
        fill_value=0
    )

    return pd.DataFrame({

        "Method": method,

        "Action": ACTION_IDS,

        "Action_Name": [
            ACTION_NAMES[i]
            for i in ACTION_IDS
        ],

        "Count": counts.values,

        "Percentage": (
            counts.values /
            len(actions)
        ) * 100

    })


distribution_df = pd.concat(
    [

        get_action_distribution(
            recorded_actions,
            "Recorded"
        ),

        get_action_distribution(
            ed3qn_actions,
            "ED3QN"
        ),

        get_action_distribution(
            trpo_actions,
            "TRPO-ED3QN"
        )

    ],
    ignore_index=True
)

distribution_df.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "Step8_Action_Distribution.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

print("\nAction Distribution:")
print(distribution_df)

# =====================================================================
# 13. CONFUSION MATRICES
# =====================================================================

cm_ed3qn = confusion_matrix(
    recorded_actions,
    ed3qn_actions,
    labels=ACTION_IDS
)

cm_trpo = confusion_matrix(
    recorded_actions,
    trpo_actions,
    labels=ACTION_IDS
)

labels = [
    ACTION_NAMES[i]
    for i in ACTION_IDS
]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(
    1,
    2,
    figsize=(15, 6)
)

sns.heatmap(
    cm_ed3qn,
    annot=True,
    fmt="d",
    cmap="Blues",
    xticklabels=labels,
    yticklabels=labels,
    ax=axes[0]
)

axes[0].set_title(
    "ED3QN Decision Agreement"
)

axes[0].set_xlabel(
    "Predicted Action"
)

axes[0].set_ylabel(
    "Recorded Action"
)

sns.heatmap(
    cm_trpo,
    annot=True,
    fmt="d",
    cmap="YlGnBu",
    xticklabels=labels,
    yticklabels=labels,
    ax=axes[1]
)

axes[1].set_title(
    "TRPO-ED3QN Decision Agreement"
)

axes[1].set_xlabel(
    "Predicted Action"
)

axes[1].set_ylabel(
    "Recorded Action"
)

plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "Step8_Confusion_Matrices.png"
    ),
    dpi=300,
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.show()

# =====================================================================
# 14. Q-VALUE COMPARISON
# =====================================================================

q_comparison = pd.DataFrame({

    "Sample_Index": np.arange(
        len(X_test)
    ),

    "ED3QN_Max_Q": ed3qn_max_q,

    "ED3QN_Selected_Q": ed3qn_selected_q,

    "TRPO_Selected_Action_Q": trpo_selected_q,

    "TRPO_Expected_Q": trpo_expected_q,

    "Policy_Confidence": policy_confidence,

    "Policy_Entropy": policy_entropy,

    "Normalized_Entropy": normalized_entropy

})

q_comparison.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "Step8_Q_Value_Comparison.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

q_summary = pd.DataFrame({

    "Metric": [

        "Mean ED3QN Maximum Q",

        "Mean ED3QN Selected Q",

        "Mean TRPO Selected Q",

        "Mean TRPO Expected Q",

        "Mean Policy Confidence",

        "Mean Policy Entropy",

        "Mean Normalized Entropy"

    ],

    "Value": [

        np.mean(ed3qn_max_q),

        np.mean(ed3qn_selected_q),

        np.mean(trpo_selected_q),

        np.mean(trpo_expected_q),

        np.mean(policy_confidence),

        np.mean(policy_entropy),

        np.mean(normalized_entropy)

    ]

})

q_summary.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "Step8_Q_Value_Summary.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

print("\nQ-value Summary:")
print(q_summary)

# =====================================================================
# 15. POLICY PROBABILITY SUMMARY
# =====================================================================

probability_summary = pd.DataFrame({

    "Action": ACTION_IDS,

    "Action_Name": [
        ACTION_NAMES[i]
        for i in ACTION_IDS
    ],

    "Mean_Probability": np.mean(
        policy_probabilities,
        axis=0
    ),

    "Standard_Deviation": np.std(
        policy_probabilities,
        axis=0
    ),

    "Minimum_Probability": np.min(
        policy_probabilities,
        axis=0
    ),

    "Maximum_Probability": np.max(
        policy_probabilities,
        axis=0
    )

})

probability_summary.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "Step8_Policy_Probability_Summary.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

# =====================================================================
# 16. POLICY PROBABILITY VISUALIZATION
# =====================================================================

plt.figure(
    figsize=(10, 6)
)

for action in ACTION_IDS:

    plt.hist(
        policy_probabilities[:, action],
        bins=40,
        alpha=0.55,
        label=ACTION_NAMES[action]
    )

plt.xlabel(
    "Policy Probability"
)

plt.ylabel(
    "Number of Test Samples"
)

plt.title(
    "TRPO-ED3QN Policy Probability Distribution"
)

plt.legend()

plt.grid(
    linestyle="--",
    alpha=0.3
)

plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "Step8_Policy_Probability_Distribution.png"
    ),
    dpi=300,
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.show()

# =====================================================================
# 17. Q-VALUE GRAPH
# =====================================================================

plt.figure(
    figsize=(11, 6)
)

plt.plot(
    np.arange(len(X_test)),
    ed3qn_max_q,
    label="ED3QN Maximum Q",
    linewidth=1.5
)

plt.plot(
    np.arange(len(X_test)),
    trpo_expected_q,
    label="TRPO Expected Q",
    linewidth=1.5
)

plt.xlabel(
    "Test Sample Index"
)

plt.ylabel(
    "Estimated Q-value"
)

plt.title(
    "ED3QN and TRPO-ED3QN Q-value Comparison"
)

plt.legend()

plt.grid(
    linestyle="--",
    alpha=0.3
)

plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "Step8_Q_Value_Comparison.png"
    ),
    dpi=300,
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.show()

# =====================================================================
# 18. OBSERVED REWARD ANALYSIS
# =====================================================================

reward_column = find_column(
    test_df,
    [
        "reward",
        "immediate_reward",
        "environment_reward"
    ]
)

if reward_column is not None:

    observed_rewards = pd.to_numeric(
        test_df[reward_column],
        errors="coerce"
    ).to_numpy()

    valid = np.isfinite(
        observed_rewards
    )

    if valid.sum() > 0:

        reward_summary = pd.DataFrame([{

            "Samples": int(valid.sum()),

            "Mean_Observed_Reward": float(
                np.mean(observed_rewards[valid])
            ),

            "Standard_Deviation": float(
                np.std(observed_rewards[valid])
            ),

            "Minimum": float(
                np.min(observed_rewards[valid])
            ),

            "Maximum": float(
                np.max(observed_rewards[valid])
            )

        }])

        reward_summary.to_csv(
            os.path.join(
                OUTPUT_DIR,
                "Step8_Observed_Reward_Summary.csv"
            ),
            index=False
        )

        reward_by_action = pd.DataFrame({

            "Recorded_Action": recorded_actions,

            "Observed_Reward": observed_rewards

        })

        reward_by_action = reward_by_action.dropna()

        reward_by_action = (
            reward_by_action
            .groupby("Recorded_Action")
            ["Observed_Reward"]
            .agg(
                ["count", "mean", "std", "min", "max"]
            )
            .reset_index()
        )

        reward_by_action["Action_Name"] = (
            reward_by_action["Recorded_Action"]
            .map(ACTION_NAMES)
        )

        reward_by_action.to_csv(
            os.path.join(
                OUTPUT_DIR,
                "Step8_Observed_Reward_By_Action.csv"
            ),
            index=False
        )

        print("\nObserved Reward Summary:")
        print(reward_summary)

        print("\nObserved Reward by Recorded Action:")
        print(reward_by_action)

else:

    print(
        "\nNo reward column found. "
        "Observed reward analysis skipped."
    )

# =====================================================================
# 19. OBSERVED LATENCY, ENERGY, COMPLETION AND TRUST ANALYSIS
# =====================================================================

outcome_candidates = {

    "Execution_Latency": [
        "execution_latency",
        "latency",
        "task_latency"
    ],

    "Energy_Consumed": [
        "energy_consumed",
        "energy",
        "energy_usage"
    ],

    "Task_Completion": [
        "task_completion",
        "completion",
        "completion_rate"
    ],

    "Trustworthiness": [
        "trustworthiness",
        "trust_score",
        "trust"
    ]

}

outcome_rows = []

for outcome_name, candidates in outcome_candidates.items():

    column = find_column(
        test_df,
        candidates
    )

    if column is None:
        continue

    values = pd.to_numeric(
        test_df[column],
        errors="coerce"
    ).dropna()

    if len(values) == 0:
        continue

    outcome_rows.append({

        "Outcome": outcome_name,

        "Source_Column": column,

        "Sample_Count": len(values),

        "Mean": float(values.mean()),

        "Standard_Deviation": float(values.std()),

        "Minimum": float(values.min()),

        "Maximum": float(values.max())

    })


if outcome_rows:

    outcome_df = pd.DataFrame(
        outcome_rows
    )

    outcome_df.to_csv(
        os.path.join(
            OUTPUT_DIR,
            "Step8_Observed_Outcome_Summary.csv"
        ),
        index=False
    )

    print("\nObserved Outcome Summary:")
    print(outcome_df)

else:

    print(
        "\nNo raw outcome columns found in the test transitions."
    )

# =====================================================================
# 20. TRPO OPTIMIZATION STATUS
# =====================================================================

optimization_status = {
    "History_Available": False,
    "Accepted_Updates": None,
    "Total_Iterations": None,
    "Status": "Unknown"
}

if os.path.exists(HISTORY_PATH):

    history_df = pd.read_csv(
        HISTORY_PATH
    )

    if "Candidate_Accepted" in history_df.columns:

        accepted_updates = int(
            history_df["Candidate_Accepted"].sum()
        )

        total_iterations = len(
            history_df
        )

        optimization_status = {

            "History_Available": True,

            "Accepted_Updates": accepted_updates,

            "Total_Iterations": total_iterations,

            "Status": (
                "No accepted policy updates"
                if accepted_updates == 0
                else "One or more policy updates accepted"
            )

        }

        print("\nTRPO Optimization Status:")
        print(optimization_status)

# =====================================================================
# 21. POLICY STABILITY ANALYSIS
# =====================================================================

agreement = np.mean(
    trpo_actions == ed3qn_actions
)

recorded_agreement = np.mean(
    trpo_actions == recorded_actions
)

ed3qn_recorded_agreement = np.mean(
    ed3qn_actions == recorded_actions
)

stability_df = pd.DataFrame([{

    "TRPO_ED3QN_vs_ED3QN_Agreement": float(
        agreement
    ),

    "TRPO_ED3QN_vs_Recorded_Agreement": float(
        recorded_agreement
    ),

    "ED3QN_vs_Recorded_Agreement": float(
        ed3qn_recorded_agreement
    ),

    "Mean_Policy_Confidence": float(
        np.mean(policy_confidence)
    ),

    "Mean_Policy_Entropy": float(
        np.mean(policy_entropy)
    ),

    "Mean_Normalized_Entropy": float(
        np.mean(normalized_entropy)
    ),

    "Accepted_TRPO_Updates": (
        optimization_status["Accepted_Updates"]
    )

}])

stability_df.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "Step8_Policy_Stability.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

# =====================================================================
# 22. FINAL MODEL COMPARISON
# =====================================================================

comparison_df = pd.DataFrame({

    "Model": [
        "Recorded Offloading",
        "ED3QN",
        "TRPO-ED3QN"
    ],

    "Action_Agreement_Percentage": [

        100.0,

        ed3qn_recorded_agreement * 100,

        recorded_agreement * 100

    ],

    "Mean_Q_Estimate": [

        np.nan,

        np.mean(ed3qn_max_q),

        np.mean(trpo_expected_q)

    ],

    "Mean_Action_Confidence": [

        np.nan,

        np.nan,

        np.mean(policy_confidence)

    ]

})

comparison_df.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "Step8_Model_Comparison.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

print("\nModel Comparison:")
print(comparison_df)

# =====================================================================
# 23. FINAL EVALUATION SUMMARY
# =====================================================================

final_summary = {

    "Test_Samples": int(len(X_test)),

    "State_Dimension": 22,

    "Action_Dimension": 4,

    "TRPO_Mean_Expected_Q": float(
        np.mean(trpo_expected_q)
    ),

    "ED3QN_Mean_Max_Q": float(
        np.mean(ed3qn_max_q)
    ),

    "TRPO_Mean_Selected_Q": float(
        np.mean(trpo_selected_q)
    ),

    "Mean_Policy_Confidence": float(
        np.mean(policy_confidence)
    ),

    "Mean_Policy_Entropy": float(
        np.mean(policy_entropy)
    ),

    "Normalized_Policy_Entropy": float(
        np.mean(normalized_entropy)
    ),

    "TRPO_ED3QN_ED3QN_Agreement": float(
        agreement
    ),

    "TRPO_Recorded_Action_Agreement": float(
        recorded_agreement
    ),

    "ED3QN_Recorded_Action_Agreement": float(
        ed3qn_recorded_agreement
    ),

    "Accepted_TRPO_Updates": (
        optimization_status["Accepted_Updates"]
    ),

    "TRPO_Optimization_Status": (
        optimization_status["Status"]
    )

}

with open(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "Step8_Final_Evaluation_Summary.json"
    ),
    "w"
) as file:

    json.dump(
        final_summary,
        file,
        indent=4
    )

pd.DataFrame(
    [final_summary]
).to_csv(
    os.path.join(

    ),

)

# =====================================================================
# 24. FINAL OUTPUT
# =====================================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("STEP 8 COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY")
print("=" * 75)

print("\nFinal Evaluation Summary:")

# =====================================================================
# STEP 9: KL-CONSTRAINED POLICY REFINEMENT AND ACTION BALANCING
# TRPO-ED3QN HYBRID EDGE OFFLOADING FRAMEWORK
# =====================================================================

import os
import re
import json
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from tensorflow.keras import layers

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# =====================================================================
# 1. REPRODUCIBILITY
# =====================================================================

SEED = 42

np.random.seed(SEED)
tf.random.set_seed(SEED)

# =====================================================================
# 2. PATH CONFIGURATION
# =====================================================================

BASE_DIR = "/content/drive/MyDrive/Datas/4905"

STEP5_DIR = os.path.join(
    BASE_DIR,
    "Step5_MDP_Environment"
)

STEP7_DIR = os.path.join(
    BASE_DIR,
    "Step7_TRPO_ED3QN_Hybrid"
)

STEP8_DIR = os.path.join(
    BASE_DIR,
    "Step8_Performance_Evaluation"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = os.path.join(
    BASE_DIR,
    "Step9_Policy_Refinement"
)

os.makedirs(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    exist_ok=True
)

TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(
    STEP5_DIR,
    "MDP_Transitions_Train.csv"
)

VAL_PATH = os.path.join(
    STEP5_DIR,
    "MDP_Transitions_Validation.csv"
)

TEST_PATH = os.path.join(
    STEP5_DIR,
    "MDP_Transitions_Test.csv"
)

POLICY_PATH = os.path.join(
    STEP7_DIR,
    "TRPO_Policy.keras"
)

ED3QN_PATH = os.path.join(
    STEP7_DIR,
    "ED3QN_Reconstructed.keras"
)

# =====================================================================
# 3. HYPERPARAMETERS
# =====================================================================

STATE_DIM = 22
ACTION_DIM = 4

KL_LIMIT = 0.01

OPTIMIZATION_ITERATIONS = 30

OPTIMIZATION_SAMPLES = 8192

INITIAL_STEP_SIZE = 0.05

BACKTRACKING_FACTOR = 0.5

MAX_BACKTRACKING_STEPS = 20

BATCH_SIZE = 512

ACTION_NAMES = {
    0: "Local",
    1: "Edge Server 1",
    2: "Edge Server 2",
    3: "Cloud"
}

ACTION_IDS = [0, 1, 2, 3]

print("=" * 75)
print("STEP 9: KL-CONSTRAINED POLICY REFINEMENT")
print("=" * 75)

# =====================================================================
# 4. VERIFY INPUT FILES
# =====================================================================

required_files = [
    TRAIN_PATH,
    VAL_PATH,
    TEST_PATH,
    POLICY_PATH,
    ED3QN_PATH
]

for path in required_files:

    if not os.path.exists(path):

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Required file not found:\n{path}"
        )

# =====================================================================
# 5. LOAD DATASETS
# =====================================================================

train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
val_df = pd.read_csv(VAL_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

print("\nDataset Shapes:")
print("Training  :", train_df.shape)
print("Validation:", val_df.shape)
print("Testing   :", test_df.shape)

# =====================================================================
# 6. EXTRACT STATE FEATURES
# =====================================================================

def get_state_columns(df):

    columns = [
        col for col in df.columns
        if re.fullmatch(
            r"state_\d+",
            str(col)
        )
    ]

    columns = sorted(
        columns,
        key=lambda x: int(x.split("_")[1])
    )

    if len(columns) != STATE_DIM:

        raise ValueError(
            f"Expected {STATE_DIM} state features, "
            f"found {len(columns)}."
        )

    return columns


state_columns = get_state_columns(train_df)

if get_state_columns(val_df) != state_columns:
    raise ValueError("Validation state columns mismatch.")

if get_state_columns(test_df) != state_columns:
    raise ValueError("Test state columns mismatch.")


X_train = train_df[
    state_columns
].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)

X_val = val_df[
    state_columns
].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)

X_test = test_df[
    state_columns
].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)


for name, matrix in [
    ("Training", X_train),
    ("Validation", X_val),
    ("Testing", X_test)
]:

    if not np.isfinite(matrix).all():

        raise ValueError(
            f"{name} state matrix contains invalid values."
        )

print("\nState Dimensions:")
print("Training  :", X_train.shape)
print("Validation:", X_val.shape)
print("Testing   :", X_test.shape)

# =====================================================================
# 7. LOAD ED3QN AND POLICY MODELS
# =====================================================================

print("\nLoading ED3QN and TRPO models...")


class DuelingAggregation(layers.Layer):

    def call(self, inputs):

        value, advantage = inputs

        return value + (
            advantage -
            tf.reduce_mean(
                advantage,
                axis=1,
                keepdims=True
            )
        )


policy = tf.keras.models.load_model(
    POLICY_PATH,
    compile=False
)

ed3qn_model = tf.keras.models.load_model(
    ED3QN_PATH,
    custom_objects={
        "DuelingAggregation": DuelingAggregation
    },
    compile=False
)

print("Policy model loaded.")
print("ED3QN model loaded.")

# =====================================================================
# 8. GENERATE ED3QN Q-VALUES
# =====================================================================

print("\nGenerating ED3QN Q-values...")

Q_train = ed3qn_model.predict(
    X_train,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    verbose=1
)

Q_val = ed3qn_model.predict(
    X_val,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    verbose=1
)

Q_test = ed3qn_model.predict(
    X_test,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    verbose=1
)

print("\nQ-value Shapes:")
print("Training  :", Q_train.shape)
print("Validation:", Q_val.shape)
print("Testing   :", Q_test.shape)

# =====================================================================
# 9. CAPTURE ORIGINAL POLICY PARAMETERS
# =====================================================================

def get_flat_parameters(model):

    return np.concatenate([
        variable.numpy().ravel()
        for variable in model.trainable_variables
    ]).astype(np.float64)


def set_flat_parameters(
    model,
    flat_parameters
):

    flat_parameters = np.asarray(
        flat_parameters,
        dtype=np.float64
    )

    position = 0

    for variable in model.trainable_variables:

        size = int(
            np.prod(variable.shape)
        )

        values = flat_parameters[
            position:position + size
        ]

        dtype = tf.as_dtype(
            variable.dtype
        ).as_numpy_dtype

        variable.assign(
            values.reshape(
                variable.shape
            ).astype(dtype)
        )

        position += size

    if position != len(flat_parameters):

        raise ValueError(
            "Policy parameter vector length mismatch."
        )


original_parameters = get_flat_parameters(
    policy
)

# =====================================================================
# 10. ORIGINAL POLICY EVALUATION
# =====================================================================

original_train_probabilities = policy.predict(
    X_train,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    verbose=0
)

original_val_probabilities = policy.predict(
    X_val,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    verbose=0
)

original_test_probabilities = policy.predict(
    X_test,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    verbose=0
)

original_train_expected_q = np.mean(
    np.sum(
        original_train_probabilities * Q_train,
        axis=1
    )
)

original_val_expected_q = np.mean(
    np.sum(
        original_val_probabilities * Q_val,
        axis=1
    )
)

original_test_expected_q = np.mean(
    np.sum(
        original_test_probabilities * Q_test,
        axis=1
    )
)

print("\nOriginal Policy Expected Q:")
print("Training  :", original_train_expected_q)
print("Validation:", original_val_expected_q)
print("Testing   :", original_test_expected_q)

# =====================================================================
# 11. PREPARE OPTIMIZATION SUBSET
# =====================================================================

rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)

sample_size = min(
    OPTIMIZATION_SAMPLES,
    len(X_train)
)

indices = rng.choice(
    len(X_train),
    size=sample_size,
    replace=False
)

X_opt = X_train[
    indices
]

Q_opt = Q_train[
    indices
]

print("\nOptimization Samples:", len(X_opt))

# =====================================================================
# 12. COMPUTE Q-VALUE ADVANTAGES
# =====================================================================

target_actions = np.argmax(
    Q_opt,
    axis=1
).astype(np.int32)

selected_q = Q_opt[
    np.arange(len(Q_opt)),
    target_actions
]

advantages = (
    selected_q -
    np.mean(Q_opt, axis=1)
)

advantages = (
    advantages - np.mean(advantages)
) / (
    np.std(advantages) + 1e-8
)

advantages = np.clip(
    advantages,
    -5.0,
    5.0
).astype(np.float32)

X_opt_tf = tf.convert_to_tensor(
    X_opt,
    dtype=tf.float32
)

actions_tf = tf.convert_to_tensor(
    target_actions,
    dtype=tf.int32
)

advantages_tf = tf.convert_to_tensor(
    advantages,
    dtype=tf.float32
)

# =====================================================================
# 13. SURROGATE POLICY OBJECTIVE
# =====================================================================

def calculate_objective_and_gradient():

    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:

        probabilities = policy(
            X_opt_tf,
            training=False
        )

        selected_probabilities = tf.gather(
            probabilities,
            actions_tf,
            axis=1,
            batch_dims=1
        )

        selected_probabilities = tf.clip_by_value(
            selected_probabilities,
            1e-8,
            1.0
        )

        objective = -tf.reduce_mean(
            advantages_tf *
            tf.math.log(selected_probabilities)
        )

    gradients = tape.gradient(
        objective,
        policy.trainable_variables
    )

    if any(
        gradient is None
        for gradient in gradients
    ):

        raise ValueError(
            "Policy gradient is missing."
        )

    flat_gradient = np.concatenate([
        gradient.numpy().ravel()
        for gradient in gradients
    ]).astype(np.float64)

    return (
        float(objective.numpy()),
        flat_gradient
    )


# =====================================================================
# 14. KL DIVERGENCE CALCULATION
# =====================================================================

def calculate_kl(
    old_probabilities,
    new_probabilities
):

    old_probabilities = np.clip(
        old_probabilities,
        1e-8,
        1.0
    )

    new_probabilities = np.clip(
        new_probabilities,
        1e-8,
        1.0
    )

    kl_values = np.sum(
        old_probabilities * (
            np.log(old_probabilities) -
            np.log(new_probabilities)
        ),
        axis=1
    )

    return float(
        np.mean(kl_values)
    )


# =====================================================================
# 15. VALIDATION EXPECTED Q-VALUE
# =====================================================================

def evaluate_validation_q():

    probabilities = policy.predict(
        X_val,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        verbose=0
    )

    expected_q = np.sum(
        probabilities * Q_val,
        axis=1
    )

    return float(
        np.mean(expected_q)
    )


# =====================================================================
# 16. KL-CONSTRAINED BACKTRACKING OPTIMIZATION
# =====================================================================

print("\nStarting KL-constrained policy refinement...")

training_history = []

old_parameters = get_flat_parameters(
    policy
)

old_probabilities = policy.predict(
    X_opt,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    verbose=0
)

old_objective, _ = (
    calculate_objective_and_gradient()
)

initial_validation_q = evaluate_validation_q()

current_step_size = INITIAL_STEP_SIZE

for iteration in range(
    OPTIMIZATION_ITERATIONS
):

    print(
        f"\nPolicy Refinement Iteration "
        f"{iteration + 1}/{OPTIMIZATION_ITERATIONS}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # Restore current accepted parameters
    # -------------------------------------------------------------

    current_parameters = get_flat_parameters(
        policy
    )

    old_probabilities = policy.predict(
        X_opt,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        verbose=0
    )

    old_objective, gradient = (
        calculate_objective_and_gradient()
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # Normalize gradient direction
    # -------------------------------------------------------------

    gradient_norm = np.linalg.norm(
        gradient
    )

    if not np.isfinite(gradient_norm) or gradient_norm < 1e-12:

        print(
            "Gradient is too small or invalid. "
            "Stopping optimization."
        )

        break

    normalized_gradient = (
        gradient /
        gradient_norm
    )

    accepted = False

    candidate_objective = old_objective
    candidate_kl = 0.0
    candidate_validation_q = evaluate_validation_q()

    used_step_size = 0.0

    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # Backtracking line search
    # -------------------------------------------------------------

    step_size = current_step_size

    for backtrack in range(
        MAX_BACKTRACKING_STEPS
    ):

        candidate_parameters = (
            current_parameters -
            step_size * normalized_gradient
        )

        set_flat_parameters(
            policy,
            candidate_parameters
        )

        candidate_probabilities = policy.predict(
            X_opt,
            batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
            verbose=0
        )

        candidate_objective, _ = (
            calculate_objective_and_gradient()
        )

        candidate_kl = calculate_kl(
            old_probabilities,
            candidate_probabilities
        )

        candidate_validation_q = (
            evaluate_validation_q()
        )

        # Accept only if:
        # 1. Surrogate objective decreases.
        # 2. KL constraint is satisfied.
        # 3. Validation expected Q does not decrease.

        objective_improved = (
            candidate_objective <
            old_objective - 1e-9
        )

        kl_satisfied = (
            candidate_kl >= -1e-8
            and candidate_kl <= KL_LIMIT
        )

        validation_not_decreased = (
            candidate_validation_q >=
            initial_validation_q - 1e-6
        )

        if (
            objective_improved
            and kl_satisfied
            and validation_not_decreased
        ):

            accepted = True

            used_step_size = step_size

            current_parameters = (
                candidate_parameters.copy()
            )

            initial_validation_q = (
                candidate_validation_q
            )

            current_step_size = min(
                step_size * 1.5,
                INITIAL_STEP_SIZE
            )

            break

        # Reject candidate and restore current parameters
        set_flat_parameters(
            policy,
            current_parameters
        )

        step_size *= BACKTRACKING_FACTOR

    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # Keep accepted policy or restore previous policy
    # -------------------------------------------------------------

    if accepted:

        set_flat_parameters(
            policy,
            current_parameters
        )

        print(
            "Policy update accepted."
        )

    else:

        set_flat_parameters(
            policy,
            current_parameters
        )

        current_step_size = (
            step_size
        )

        print(
            "No acceptable candidate found in line search."
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # Record optimization metrics
    # -------------------------------------------------------------

    current_probabilities = policy.predict(
        X_opt,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        verbose=0
    )

    current_objective, _ = (
        calculate_objective_and_gradient()
    )

    current_kl = calculate_kl(
        old_probabilities,
        current_probabilities
    )

    current_validation_q = (
        evaluate_validation_q()
    )

    training_history.append({

        "Iteration": iteration + 1,

        "Objective": float(
            current_objective
        ),

        "Validation_Expected_Q": float(
            current_validation_q
        ),

        "KL_Divergence": float(
            current_kl
        ),

        "Gradient_Norm": float(
            gradient_norm
        ),

        "Step_Size": float(
            used_step_size
        ),

        "Candidate_Accepted": int(
            accepted
        )

    })

    print(
        f"Objective: {current_objective:.8f} | "
        f"Validation Q: {current_validation_q:.6f} | "
        f"KL: {current_kl:.8f} | "
        f"Gradient Norm: {gradient_norm:.6f} | "
        f"Accepted: {accepted}"
    )

# =====================================================================
# 17. SAVE OPTIMIZATION HISTORY
# =====================================================================

history_df = pd.DataFrame(
    training_history
)

history_df.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "Step9_Optimization_History.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

# =====================================================================
# 18. GENERATE REFINED POLICY PREDICTIONS
# =====================================================================

print("\nEvaluating refined policy...")

refined_train_probabilities = policy.predict(
    X_train,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    verbose=1
)

refined_val_probabilities = policy.predict(
    X_val,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    verbose=1
)

refined_test_probabilities = policy.predict(
    X_test,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    verbose=1
)

refined_train_expected_q = np.mean(
    np.sum(
        refined_train_probabilities * Q_train,
        axis=1
    )
)

refined_val_expected_q = np.mean(
    np.sum(
        refined_val_probabilities * Q_val,
        axis=1
    )
)

refined_test_expected_q = np.mean(
    np.sum(
        refined_test_probabilities * Q_test,
        axis=1
    )
)

refined_test_actions = np.argmax(
    refined_test_probabilities,
    axis=1
)

# =====================================================================
# 19. COMPARE ORIGINAL AND REFINED POLICY
# =====================================================================

original_test_actions = np.argmax(
    original_test_probabilities,
    axis=1
)

policy_agreement = np.mean(
    original_test_actions ==
    refined_test_actions
)

refined_confidence = np.max(
    refined_test_probabilities,
    axis=1
)

refined_entropy = -np.sum(
    refined_test_probabilities *
    np.log(
        np.clip(
            refined_test_probabilities,
            1e-10,
            1.0
        )
    ),
    axis=1
)

# =====================================================================
# 20. ACTION DISTRIBUTION
# =====================================================================

def get_distribution(
    actions,
    method
):

    counts = pd.Series(
        actions
    ).value_counts().reindex(
        ACTION_IDS,
        fill_value=0
    )

    return pd.DataFrame({

        "Method": method,

        "Action": ACTION_IDS,

        "Action_Name": [
            ACTION_NAMES[i]
            for i in ACTION_IDS
        ],

        "Count": counts.values,

        "Percentage": (
            counts.values /
            len(actions)
        ) * 100

    })


distribution_df = pd.concat(
    [

        get_distribution(
            original_test_actions,
            "Original TRPO-ED3QN"
        ),

        get_distribution(
            refined_test_actions,
            "Refined TRPO-ED3QN"
        )

    ],
    ignore_index=True
)

distribution_df.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "Step9_Action_Distribution.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

print("\nAction Distribution:")
print(distribution_df)

# =====================================================================
# 21. Q-VALUE COMPARISON
# =====================================================================

original_expected_q = np.sum(
    original_test_probabilities * Q_test,
    axis=1
)

refined_expected_q = np.sum(
    refined_test_probabilities * Q_test,
    axis=1
)

q_comparison = pd.DataFrame({

    "Sample_Index": np.arange(
        len(X_test)
    ),

    "Original_TRPO_Expected_Q": (
        original_expected_q
    ),

    "Refined_TRPO_Expected_Q": (
        refined_expected_q
    ),

    "ED3QN_Maximum_Q": np.max(
        Q_test,
        axis=1
    )

})

q_comparison.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "Step9_Q_Value_Comparison.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

# =====================================================================
# 22. POLICY COMPARISON SUMMARY
# =====================================================================

comparison_summary = pd.DataFrame({

    "Metric": [

        "Training Expected Q",

        "Validation Expected Q",

        "Test Expected Q",

        "Mean Policy Confidence",

        "Mean Policy Entropy",

        "Policy Agreement Percentage"

    ],

    "Original_TRPO": [

        original_train_expected_q,

        original_val_expected_q,

        original_test_expected_q,

        np.mean(
            np.max(
                original_test_probabilities,
                axis=1
            )
        ),

        np.mean(
            -np.sum(
                original_test_probabilities *
                np.log(
                    np.clip(
                        original_test_probabilities,
                        1e-10,
                        1.0
                    )
                ),
                axis=1
            )
        ),

        np.nan

    ],

    "Refined_TRPO": [

        refined_train_expected_q,

        refined_val_expected_q,

        refined_test_expected_q,

        np.mean(refined_confidence),

        np.mean(refined_entropy),

        policy_agreement * 100

    ]

})

comparison_summary.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "Step9_Policy_Comparison.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

print("\nPolicy Comparison:")
print(comparison_summary)

# =====================================================================
# 23. SAVE REFINED POLICY PREDICTIONS
# =====================================================================

prediction_df = pd.DataFrame({

    "Sample_Index": np.arange(
        len(X_test)
    ),

    "Original_Action": original_test_actions,

    "Refined_Action": refined_test_actions,

    "Original_Expected_Q": original_expected_q,

    "Refined_Expected_Q": refined_expected_q,

    "Refined_Confidence": refined_confidence,

    "Refined_Entropy": refined_entropy

})

for action in ACTION_IDS:

    prediction_df[
        f"Refined_Probability_Action_{action}"
    ] = refined_test_probabilities[:, action]

prediction_df.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "Step9_Refined_Test_Predictions.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

# =====================================================================
# 24. SAVE REFINED POLICY
# =====================================================================

policy.save(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "TRPO_ED3QN_Refined_Policy.keras"
    )
)

print("\nRefined policy saved.")

# =====================================================================
# 25. OPTIMIZATION CURVE
# =====================================================================

if not history_df.empty:

    fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(
        figsize=(10, 6)
    )

    ax1.plot(
        history_df["Iteration"],
        history_df["Objective"],
        marker="o",
        label="Surrogate Objective"
    )

    ax1.set_xlabel(
        "Optimization Iteration"
    )

    ax1.set_ylabel(

    )

    )

    )

    fig.tight_layout()

    plt.savefig(

        ),

    )

    plt.show()

# =====================================================================
# 26. ACTION DISTRIBUTION GRAPH
# =====================================================================

pivot_df = distribution_df.pivot(
    index="Action_Name",

)

pivot_df.plot(

    ),

)

plt.show()

# =====================================================================
# 27. SAVE CONFIGURATION

configuration = {

    ),

    ),
